assessments.rationale: The training-data section affirmatively states that full transcripts train the model and that no redaction or filtering step exists — the documented shortfall the conclusion rests on.
The components section affirmatively states the exporter's job identity is the only principal with write access to the training store.

The artifacts section establishes date-named artifacts and most-recent serving; no passage names a registry or states that an artifact records the base model and training-data version it was built from, so lineage cannot be verified from the documents.
missing_evidence: documentation naming the artifact registry and its recorded lineage fields
